meta.name: understand-explain
meta.description: Use when you need a deep-dive explanation of a specific file, function, or module in the codebase

copy.tagline: 深入理解代码库中的任意文件或函数
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要快速理解不熟悉的代码模块
copy.tagline_en: Deep-dive into any file or function in the codebase
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to quickly understand unfamiliar code modules

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能对代码库中的特定文件、函数或模块进行深入解释，包括其架构角色、内部结构、外部连接和数据流。
howto.when: 当你需要详细了解某个代码组件（如文件、函数或模块）时，可以要求 Claude 解释它。

say.text: 解释一下 src/auth/login.ts 这个文件的作用。
say.note: Claude 会分析该文件在架构中的角色和连接。

say.text: 帮我深入讲解 verifyToken 函数。
say.note: Claude 会查找该函数并解释其内部逻辑和依赖。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can provide a thorough explanation of a specific file, function, or module in the codebase, including its architectural role, internal structure, external connections, and data flow.
howto.when_en: When you need a deep-dive explanation of a specific code component (e.g., file, function, or module), you can ask Claude to explain it.

say_en.text: Explain the role of src/auth/login.ts file.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze the file's architectural role and connections.

say_en.text: Give me a deep dive on the verifyToken function.
say_en.note: Claude will locate the function and explain its internal logic and dependencies.
